The brain runs on ~20 watts. Many AI workloads, especially always-on edge tasks, use far more energy per task.

Neuromorphic and edge AI could help, but students and solo developers often can't access the hardware, tools or mentors.

My humble request to universities, labs and companies: open the door for newcomers.
